_note: Network profile switch (M3, SPEC 14.10): the one place that says devnet or mainnet. Every service (Core, indexer, runtime, trader, the web server) and the pages (through /chain/config) read it; LINEAGE_NETWORK overrides `network` for one process (the site's env file). devnet is the default and behaves as before. mainnet: no faucet, no TEST labels, the quote token below, a keyed RPC from LINEAGE_MAINNET_RPC (or HELIUS_MAINNET_RPC in ~/.config/lineage/rpc.env; never printed, never sent to a browser, no public fallback), the Jupiter swap path on, priority fees from getRecentPrioritizationFees capped below. $LINE does not exist on mainnet yet: quote.mint is a stand-in (PYUSD, the same mint as config/swap.json target_mint) and quote.line_mint stays null (TBA) until the owner sets it and quote.status to live. No USD price feed is wired: usd_feed null means quote-token amounts only, no USD figures.
